block.sakura_bloom.bamboo_steamer.hint: Place above a heat source. Use ingredients to add them, then use an empty hand to steam. Serve finished dishes in their required container.
block.sakura_bloom.iron_wok.hint: Place above a heat source. Use ingredients to add them, then use an empty hand to start cooking. Serve finished dishes in their required container.
jei.sakura_bloom.serving: Use this container to serve the finished dish
jei.sakura_bloom.cabbage_seeds: Harvest wild cabbage on beaches or cabbage in village farms. Farmers can sow these seeds.
jei.sakura_bloom.tomato_seeds: Harvest tomatoes in village farms. Farmers can sow these seeds.
jei.sakura_bloom.rice_seeds: Harvest wild rice in shallow riverbanks. Sow in water over farmland and leave space for the panicle.
message.sakura_bloom.cooking.bowl: Use the bowl to serve the dish once it is cooked.
message.sakura_bloom.cooking.full: The cookware is full. Sneak-use with an empty hand to return the ingredients.
message.sakura_bloom.cooking.ingredient: This item is not used by this cookware.
message.sakura_bloom.cooking.no_recipe: These ingredients do not match a recipe. Sneak-use with an empty hand to collect them.
message.sakura_bloom.cooking.heat: Put a heat source under the cookware, such as a lit campfire.
message.sakura_bloom.cooking.ready: The dish is ready. Use an empty hand to collect it.
message.sakura_bloom.cooking.serve_with: The dish is ready. Use %s to serve it.
message.sakura_bloom.cooking.serving: The dish is ready. Use the container shown in its recipe.
block.sakura_bloom.tea_kettle.hint: Add a water bottle, then a blossom petal. Use an empty hand to collect the tea.
block.sakura_bloom.tea_kettle.empty: Use a water bottle on the kettle to fill it.
block.sakura_bloom.tea_kettle.water: Add weeping, double, or mountain cherry petals. Sneak-use with empty hands to take the bottle back.
jei.sakura_bloom.tea_kettle.instructions: Add water, then petals. Collect with empty hands after 4 seconds.
